audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (1) The page calls The Equalizer 'a channel with a telegraph' and builds the level-6 plan on executing him out of that channel — Riot's text says he fires a group of rockets creating a wall of flames, and the kit lists no channel flag. (2) Scrap Shield is treated as the matchup-defining cooldown to wait out; it is 6 seconds flat, so it is essentially always available. (3) Electro-Harpoon's Magic Resist shred and its 2-harpoon, 850-range, 0.5s-recharge nature are never mentioned.
audit.why: Every one of those changes what the player does. Waiting for a 6s shield is waiting forever — the real lockout is Overheat, where at 100% Heat he cannot cast any spell at all, and that is the window to blink in. And the MR shred means his follow-up hurts more than the health bar suggests, which is the argument for the trade being short.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, late, wants.you[1], mid, report[5].t and dosFull[0].d now state R's 130s at rank 1 and 1750-range wall (no channel claim), the 6s Scrap Shield, the Overheat lockout, and Electro-Harpoon's 2 charges / 850 range / MR shred.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page pointed the player at the wrong cooldown entirely.
audit.why: The punishable state here is not a spell on cooldown, it is Overheat — a self-inflicted lockout with no spells for its duration. Scrap Shield's 6s can never be played around.
audit.corrected: report[5].t and dosFull[0].d now name Overheat as the commit window.

notes: focus.text, loading, winCon, enemyWin and the trade lines all pin this matchup on Scrap Shield, which the kit shows is a 6-second cooldown — the weakest possible thing to build a page around. The right focus is his Heat bar. I fixed it wherever the sentence carried mechanics, but retargeting the focus label itself is a champion-level change across a dozen strings and should be a deliberate decision, not a side effect of this audit. Also of note for item advice: Electro-Harpoon reduces Magic Resist, so MR purchases into Rumble are worth less than they look — report[8].t currently says nothing about MR here, so no edit was needed.
